name: @forgotten-industries/archive
description: Canonical archive data for Forgotten Industries machines, parts, field logs, and restoration dossiers.

scripts.dev:continuance: npm run build:css && ruby scripts/build.rb && node scripts/build_continuance_index.cjs && (cd continuance && vite)
scripts.build:site: npm run clean:site && npm run build:derivatives && ruby scripts/build.rb && npm run build:continuance && npm run build:game && eleventy && sh scripts/build_css.sh --minify && npm run build:csp && npm run audit:public
scripts.serve:site: npm run clean:site && npm run build:derivatives && ruby scripts/build.rb && npm run build:continuance && npm run build:game && sh scripts/build_css.sh && eleventy --serve
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:site && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler dev --local
scripts.worker:dry-run: npm run build:site && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build:site && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler deploy

author: Matthew Taylor Marx
